confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from a search result that quoted the RBA table, which showed AUD/USD 0.6720 for 18 Nov 2026. Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors come from two crowdsourced indexes (MyLifeElsewhere and Traveltables, the latter last updated in July 2023). They agree within roughly $0.50. Restaurant, tourist-area and hotel-restaurant prices run higher than those averages, so the beer and meal anchors are adjusted upward. The mid-range meal for two is a holistic estimate, with no direct source found. The cocktail anchor draws on one search that found an indicative range of 250-400 THB (about $7-12) plus a 98 THB budget example. No wine-by-the-glass price was found, so wine is set at roughly the cocktail level, a typical imported-wine premium over beer in Thailand. All accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge. I did not search for or inspect any accommodation listings. Prices vary widely by area (Chaweng and Bophut are pricier) and by season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Thai island tourist destinations such as Phuket and Krabi. The MyLifeElsewhere index puts Koh Samui about 18% above the Thai national average, and restaurant prices about 12% above it.
